data.title: Date Picker
data.tagline: Choose a date or date range from a calendar
data.description: A date picker reduces ambiguity by showing dates in a calendar. It may select one day or a range. State the allowed dates, whether the start and end days are included, and which time zone applies when people work across regions.

use: A date with clear availability rules
avoid: Use a calendar for a year that is faster to type
Mix date formats without explaining them

lessonPractice.title: A hotel booking needs check-in and check-out dates. Sold-out dates are unavailable and check-out must be later. How should input work?

options.label: Use a date-range picker, disable unavailable dates, and validate the order as users select
options.feedback: One range control keeps the format consistent, exposes availability, and maintains the relationship between both dates.

options.label: Use two free-text fields and validate formats and order only after submission
options.feedback: Free text introduces format ambiguity and hides unavailable dates until after the user finishes the form.

options.label: Use two unrelated calendars and only check whether each date is available
options.feedback: Two individually available dates do not guarantee a valid range; check-out could still precede check-in.

data.agentPrompt: Build check-in and check-out as a linked date-range picker. Disable sold-out and invalid dates, require check-out after check-in, and state whether the end date is included. Test cross-month selection, changing check-in, and no-availability states.
